Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.springboot.kafka

Class KafkaEventListeners

java.lang.Object
eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.springboot.kafka.KafkaEventListeners
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.context.Lifecycle, org.springframework.context.Phased, org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
public class KafkaEventListeners extends Object implements org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
One Kafka listener container per queue-triggered function. A message is committed only after the function returned; when it throws, the message is delivered again, up to the maximum number of attempts, and then published to <topic>.DLT (or logged and skipped when the service has no KafkaOperations to publish with).

  • Constructor Details

    • KafkaEventListeners

      public KafkaEventListeners(List<EventEndpoint> endpoints, org.springframework.kafka.core.ConsumerFactory<?,?> consumerFactory, org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaOperations<?,?> kafkaOperations, String groupIdPrefix, int maxAttempts, Duration backoff)
      Parameters:
      endpoints - all event endpoints of the service; only the queue-triggered ones are used
      consumerFactory - the consumer factory of the service, whose settings are reused with string deserializers
      kafkaOperations - publishes messages to the dead letter topic; null to log and skip them
      groupIdPrefix - prefix of the consumer group of each function
      maxAttempts - how often a message is delivered before it is given up
      backoff - pause between two attempts
